pair.intro: Enter your AX PRO panel's IP address and the login you use for its web page.
pair.err_locked: The panel has locked this address after failed logins. Wait {s} seconds and try again.
pair.err_auth: Login refused (401). Use a local Administrator user on the panel — cloud (Hik-Connect) accounts cannot log in locally.
pair.err_400: The panel rejected the login request (400 {reason}). Please send a diagnostic report from the app settings.
pair.err_unreachable: Cannot reach the panel at {host} (HTTP, port 80). Check the IP address and that Homey is on the same network.
